thread:
Jordan (CS Ops): quick sync re: Mistral pilot onboarding tomorrow. two items: telemetry/consent flow and week1 success metrics. need leads so we don't scramble post-call.
Mei (Mistral PM): thanks Jordan. i can help confirm what we can expose for telemetry. their legal team is ok with anonymized usage but wants explicit consent recorded.
Devin (Solutions): i'll run the integration walkthrough and show the telemetry toggle in the console. can someone confirm which telemetry keys we show to customers?
Rhea (Security): list of allowed telemetry: api_calls_total, avg_latency_ms, error_rate. no request payloads, no user texts. we must show an explicit checkbox and store consent timestamp. compliance requires retention window note.
Ben (Account): flag: customer asked about billing visibility tied to telemetry sampling. Mei can you ask if they want cost-per-feature breakdown in the dashboard?
Mei (Mistral PM): yes they want cost visibility. prefer a weekly CSV export first. can we offer a simple "estimated cost" field in week1 summary?
Jordan (CS Ops): action items: Devin -> demo telemetry toggle + where consent shows; Rhea -> short consent copy for form; Ben -> confirm billing export cadence; Mei -> confirm legal ok with anonymized metrics and CSV ask. owners by EOD today?
Devin (Solutions): assigned. will include a short snippet for devs to enable SDK telemetry sampling:
```
// enable telemetry sampling (go)
client.ConfigureTelemetry(TelemetryConfig{SampleRate:0.05})
```
Rhea (Security): consent copy draft: "I consent to Redwood and Mistral collecting anonymized usage metrics (latency, errors, call counts) for the purpose of improving service and troubleshooting. No request content will be stored. Consent timestamp: [auto]." any objections?
Ben (Account): copy fine. i'll tee up CSV export for weekly exports (s3 link) and note estimated cost calculation in the summary.
Mei (Mistral PM): legal wants retention window noted: 90 days for aggregated metrics. please add that to the consent copy.
Rhea (Security): updated consent copy: "... for the purpose of improving service and troubleshooting. Aggregated metrics retained for 90 days. No request content will be stored. Consent timestamp: [auto]."
Jordan (CS Ops): great. Miguel (not on thread) please forgive tagging, can you add a "telemetry consent" checkbox field to the week1 feedback form and a freeform for "billing concerns"? @cs-bot set a reminder to follow up on consent statuses 7 days after enablement.
cs-bot: Reminder set: "Check pilot telemetry consents (Mistral)" scheduled for 2026-07-28T16:00:00Z  will notify #customer-success and listed assignees.
Devin (Solutions): i'll demo the consent flow and show how customers can opt-out. will also record an internal 3-min clip for the support queue.
Mei (Mistral PM): perfect. one more ask: we'd like a one-page "what we collect" graphic for legal to attach when inviting internal stakeholders. can someone mock that up?
Ben (Account): i can put together the one-pager and include the CSV example. will drop in shared drive by EOD.
Jordan (CS Ops): solid. i'll assemble a one-week success metric email template (opens, key flows attempted, avg latency, top-3 pain points) and put in tracker. we'll reconvene here after the kick. :rocket:
